async def act(page):
    # Navigate directly to the Manage Products page using relative URL
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin/catalog_product/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Click on the button to add a new product
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Add Product').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Fill in product name
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Product Name').fill('Swaatch Smart Watch')
    # Fill in price
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Price').fill('769.99')
    # Navigate to Inventory section if available
    inventory_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Inventory')
    if await inventory_link.count() > 0:
        await inventory_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Fill in stock quantity
    qty_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Qty')
    if await qty_input.count() > 0:
        await qty_input.fill('42')
    # Navigate to Attributes section for size and color if available
    attributes_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Attributes')
    if await attributes_link.count() > 0:
        await attributes_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Select size 'uni-size' if combobox exists
    size_combobox = page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Size')
    if await size_combobox.count() > 0:
        await size_combobox.select_option('uni-size')
    # Select color 'Blue' if combobox exists
    color_combobox = page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Color')
    if await color_combobox.count() > 0:
        await color_combobox.select_option('Blue')
    # Save the product
    save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save')
    if await save_button.count() > 0:
        await save_button.click()
    else:
        save_button_alt = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save Product')
        if await save_button_alt.count() > 0:
            await save_button_alt.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Additional wait to ensure save completes
